name: Why is my shower still leaking after replacing the cartridge?

mainEntity.name: Why is my shower still leaking after replacing the cartridge?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your shower is still leaking after a cartridge replacement, it could be due to several factors. The new cartridge might be faulty, or it may not have been installed correctly, leading to improper sealing. Alternatively, the issue might not have been the cartridge itself but a problem with the shower valve body or other internal components that are now exposed. It's crucial to ensure the correct cartridge type was used for your specific faucet model, as slight variations can prevent a proper seal. If you've attempted a DIY replacement and the leak persists, consider contacting CG Plumbing Solutions for a professional assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A leak after replacement could mean a faulty new cartridge, improper installation, or an underlying issue with the shower valve body itself. Ensure the correct cartridge type was used.
